schedule.sourceLine: As of September 30, 2026, approximately $18 million of our outstanding debt of approximately $9.6 billion is due within the next 12 months.

subFacilities.sourceLine: The ABL Facility includes borrowing capacity available for letters of credit of $200 million.

uncommitted.description: additional borrowing capacity under the ABL Facility
uncommitted.sourceLine: At September 30, 2026, the Company had no outstanding borrowings and approximately $745 million of additional borrowing capacity (after taking into consideration the $32 million of outstanding letters of credit) under the ABL Facility.

faces.sourceLine: Upon completion of the tender offer, approximately $689 million principal amount of the 4.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 remained outstanding

Upon completion of the tender offer, approximately $689 million principal amount of the 4.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 remained outstanding, and approximately $1.549 billion principal amount of the 10.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2032 remained outstanding.

maturities.sourceLine: Principal amounts outstanding under the ABL Facility will be due and payable in full on June 5, 2029.

price.value: 103% of the principal amount, plus accrued and unpaid interest
price.sourceLine: On February 2, 2026, the Company exercised a special call provision to redeem 10 % of the original principal amount, or approximately $ 223 million, of the 10.875 % Senior Secured Notes due 2032 , at a redemption price of 103 % of the principal amount, plus accrued and unpaid interest.

moves.sourceLine: On February 2, 2026, the Company exercised a special call provision to redeem 10 % of the original principal amount, or approximately $ 223 million, of the 10.875 % Senior Secured Notes due 2032 , at a redemption price of 103 % of the principal amount, plus accrued and unpaid interest.

funding.value: approximately $ 600 million of cash on hand from recent divestiture proceeds
funding.sourceLine: The Company used approximately $ 600 million of cash on hand from recent divestiture proceeds to repurchase approximately $ 368 million principal amount of its 4.750 % Senior Secured Notes due 2031

moves.sourceLine: The Company used approximately $ 600 million of cash on hand from recent divestiture proceeds to repurchase approximately $ 368 million principal amount of its 4.750 % Senior Secured Notes due 2031 , or approximately 35 % of the total outstanding principal amount, and to repurchase approximately $ 231 million principal amount of its 10.875 % Senior Secured Notes due 2032 , or approximately 13 % of the total outstanding principal amount, that were validly tendered and accepted for purchase pursuant to a tender offer that launched on April 22, 2026, and was completed on May 6, 2026, and to pay related fees and expenses.
